source: ClientCare Social row 13: Myth: you need a perfect credit score to buy a home.
hookSub: It comes up in almost every first conversation with a new buyer

slides.big: A score does not need to be flawless
slides.small: Different loan types have different minimum guidelines. FHA allows 3.5% down with a 580 score.

slides.big: Lenders look at the full picture
slides.small: Your income, your other debts, your savings and your payment history, not one number in isolation.

slides.big: Checking your own credit won't hurt it
slides.small: Looking at your own credit report is not a new credit inquiry, so it does not lower your score.

slides.big: Find out before you house hunt
slides.small: Not after you find a home you love. Then you know exactly what to work on, if anything.
